body.condition: The global signal obeys \(\psi\ge n^{1/2+\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^8\) for a fixed \(\eta\in(0,1/4)\).

novel.justification: The regime includes bounded-incoherence rank-one panels with \(H\asymp n\) and \(\psi=n^{4/5}\) for small positive \(\eta\), so it permits factors polynomially weaker than the strong-factor singular-value order \(n\).
